backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a poetry platform with user profiles, poems (text/image), collections, notifications, authorization mixins, blob storage, draft mode toggle, and version management (9.0.0).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the "Publish to production" feature implementation with references to frontend hooks and admin panel components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the poetry platform application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color format, defining design tokens for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title "International Gojri Maa Boli Adab" and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes (home, poem detail, admin forms, collections, admin panel), QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and global Layout/UserProfileSetup components.
Empty file with no content (unused route guard component).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation (home, add poem, collections, admin panel for authenticated users), login button, notification bell, and footer with attribution and Caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component using Internet Identity for login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBell: Bell icon button with unread notification count badge that opens a popover containing the NotificationPanel component.
frontend/src/components/NotificationPane: Scrollable notification list panel displaying messages with timestamps, read/unread status, and mark-as-read functionality using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Displays a poem in a card format with image or text layout, showing metadata (title, author, date, type) and providing functionality to add the poem to collections via a dialog with checkboxes.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, blocking interaction until profile setup is complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including poems, collections, user profiles, notifications, search, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global styles with Tailwind configuration, custom CSS variables for warm earth-tone color scheme in light/dark modes, and font family definitions using Crimson Text, Lora, and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin form page for submitting new poems (text or image) with title, author, content, and collection assignments. Handles image upload with progress tracking and requires Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for assigning admin roles to users via Principal ID and publishing draft content to production. Includes authentication checks and draft mode status display.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionManager.tsx: Collection management page allowing authenticated users to create collections, add/remove poems to/from collections, view collection contents, and delete collections. Features dialog-based poem selection interface.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main landing page displaying all poems with search functionality (debounced), collection filtering, and responsive grid layout. Shows loading states and handles empty results.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: Detailed poem view page showing full poem content (text or image), metadata, associated collections, and download options. Allows authenticated users to add the poem to additional collections.
frontend/src/utils/downloadHelpers.ts: Utility functions for downloading images from URLs or Blobs and sanitizing filenames by replacing non-alphanumeric characters with underscores.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Utility function that converts backend Time type (nanoseconds as BigInt) to human-readable date string in "Month Day, Year" format.
frontend/src/utils/poemImageGenerator.ts: Generates a shareable PNG image of a poem on a canvas with decorative borders, gradients, and styled text including title, content, author, and branding.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH, typography settings with custom font families (Inter, Crimson Text, Lora), and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata file tracking the International Gojri Poetry Platform's state, including one existing feature to publish Version 9 to production with a permanent URL.
